name: varg-mascot-jingle-ad
description: Turns a product into a singing mascot ad on varg: the product itself as a claymation, plush or 3D-family-film character with a face built for lip-sync, a 15-30 s jingle with the brand name in the hook (Lyria 3.5 with timed lyric sections, trimmed to length), the mascot singing it on Seedance 2.5 with the song as an audio reference, the master song laid back on top, lyric captions and a real product end card. Non-human ads skip the "fake person" problem, get shared and suit dropshipping products. Use when a seller asks for a jingle ad, a singing product, a mascot ad, a claymation or cartoon product video, a song ad for TikTok or Reels, or a talking product character. Not for full music videos for songs (varg-music-video), human UGC actors (ai-ugc-ad-video), or original characters without a product (varg-character-absurd).
